risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (299.68) indicates extreme market stress, earnings binary event in 8 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (three white soldiers, ADX bullish, Supertrend, RSI rising) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity and price near support (20.5446) offers defined risk entry for swing traders.
